16116-studies-of-trees.title: Studies Of Trees
16116-studies-of-trees.creator: J.J. Levison, M.F.
16116-studies-of-trees.description: A book by J.J. Levison, M.F.. In this chapter the characterizations are based, as far as possible, on peculiarities that are evident all year round. In almost every tree there is some one trait that marks its individuality and separates it, at a glance, from all other trees. It may be the general form of the tree, its mode of branching, bark, bud or fruit.

55997-an-illustrated-handbook-of-mount-v.title: An Illustrated Handbook Of Mount Vernon The Home Of Washingt
55997-an-illustrated-handbook-of-mount-v.creator: Unknown
55997-an-illustrated-handbook-of-mount-v.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. miles south of the present city of Washington, became the property of John Washington and Nicholas Spencer. Half of this tract, or 2,500 acres, descended to Lawrence Washington, who, in 1743, built a residence, and named the estate Mount Vernon, after the British Admiral under whom he had served. At Lawrence Washington’s death (1752) the estate passed to the ownership of his half brother, George Washington, who subsequently extended the boundaries of his plantation until they included nearly 8,000 acres.

arxiv-2004-07967.title: Multiple Visual-Semantic Embedding for Video Retrieval from Query Sentence
arxiv-2004-07967.creator: Huy Manh Nguyen, Tomo Miyazaki, Yoshihiro Sugaya, and Shinichiro Omachi
arxiv-2004-07967.description: Abstract Visual-semantic embedding aims to learn a joint embedding space where related video and sentence instances are located close to each other. Most existing methods put instances in a single embedding space. However, they struggle to embed instances due to the difficulty of matching visual dynamics in videos to textual features in sentences.

arxiv-2109-10844.creator: Emanuel Carneiro, Andrés Chirre and Micah B. Milinovich
arxiv-2109-10844.description: Abstract . Generalizing previous work of Iwaniec, Luo, and Sarnak (2000), we use information from one-level density theorems to estimate the proportion of non-vanishing of L L -functions in a family at a low-lying height on the critical line (measured by the analytic conductor).

arxiv-2112-11003.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Samudra Sur 1 , Adithi Udupa 1 and Diptiman Sen 1,2. We study the effects of a periodically varying electric field on the Hubbard model at half-filling on a triangular lattice. The electric field is incorporated through the phase of the nearest-neighbor hopping amplitude via the Peierls prescription. pmc-11499657.title: Arthroscopic mini tunnel suture bridge for ACL tibial avulsion fractures repair
pmc-11499657.creator: Jin-Song Pu, Lin Zheng, Chang-Chun Jian
pmc-11499657.description: The study presents an arthroscopic transosseous suture bridge technique for repairing avulsion fractures of the tibial insertion of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), specifically tailored for adolescent patients. The technique utilizes two mini tunnels, integrating the principles of transosseous tunneling and suture bridging to ensure stable fixation while minimizing the impact on the bone bed.

pmc-12692907.title: Synthesis of Nanoparticles of Different Morphology in a DC Discharge
pmc-12692907.creator: Alexander V Fedoseev, Anatoly V Filippov, Mikhail M Vasiliev, Oleg F Petrov, Ming-Yu Li
pmc-12692907.description: The synthesis of nanoparticles in the plasma of a stratified DC gas discharge was carried out under typical gas discharge conditions, i.e., at room temperature and an argon pressure of 0.11 torr, with a discharge current of 2.5 mA. The particles were formed and grown due to the sputtering of a dielectric plasma concentrator, which was used for strata stabilization.

pmc-12963933.title: Exposure‐Response Associations Between Air Pollution and Laboratory‐Confirmed Influenza Cases in Anhui Province, China: A Two‐Stage Modeling Study
pmc-12963933.creator: Harry Asena Musonye, Yi‐Sheng He, Lei Gong, Sai Hou, Junling Yu, Wei Chen, Peng Wang, Jun He, Hai‐Feng Pan
pmc-12963933.description: Influenza remains a global public health and socio‐economic threat, and air pollution is believed to increase its risk. However, relatively few studies have focused specifically on laboratory‐confirmed influenza (LCI), which limits the precision and reliability of existing evidence on this association. We sought to explore the relationship between air pollution and LCI cases in Anhui province, China.

pmc-13292393.description: This study evaluated the impact of cold plasma (CP) treatment on the structural and digestive properties of soybean protein isolate (SPI)–Aronia melanocarpa extract (AME) complexes. CP treatment significantly modified the secondary structure of SPI–AME complexes, while AME addition enhanced protein stability by increasing α-helix content.

pmc-13538572.title: Nutrient starvation and phosphonate utilization coordinate buoyancy and high-light tolerance in Trichodesmium
pmc-13538572.creator: Chuze Zou, Guang Gao, Xin Lin, Mina Bizic, Ilana Berman-Frank, Kunshan Gao
pmc-13538572.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The formation of surface blooms by the diazotrophic cyanobacterium Trichodesmium contributes extensively to carbon and nitrogen cycling. Yet the physiological drivers governing its vertical ascent and subsequent tolerance to high surface irradiance remain obscure. By measuring sinking and floating velocities, analyzing transcriptome responses, and tracking the subcellular distribution of gas vesicles, we show that nutrient starvation is the primary trigger for vertical ascent.
